findings: The controller is_daily_cycle_persona checks lifecycle and status only. reconcile_once passes the unfiltered owner list to PersonaCronRegistrar.reconcile_daily_cycles, which independently selects paper_owner, paper_running and consultable records. Changing only is_daily_cycle_persona cannot prevent registration or consumption of the servant's daily run.

The existing persona_policy_resolver.evaluate_participant_action_capability contains every required advisory exclusion, plus origin=agora_advisor and consult_policy_id=consult-panel.non-trading. Its enrollment predicate must be reused without making cycle enrollment depend on capability snapshots, harness readiness, or policy resolution.

The existing fleet_classification classifier recognizes consult_panel and agora_servant but does not recognize persona_class=agora_advisor, origin=private_servant/agora_advisor or owner_scope=user_private. Simply reusing it would miss required exclusions.

The BFF fleet list emits persona_purpose and owner_lifecycle_state but not the raw owner identity metadata. Probe filtering on the current persona_purpose projection would exclude the incident servant, but could still disagree with the controller for the other required metadata variants.

The persona-day workflow installs no service dependencies and executes python3 -I acceptance/persona_day.py. A shared predicate must remain accessible through a stdlib-only source loader; importing the controller or relying on ambient PYTHONPATH is unsuitable.
proposed_implementation: Extract the existing owner advisory identity predicate into a pure helper in persona_policy_resolver, preserving the capability evaluator's existing lifecycle and status checks and reusing the helper there.

Reuse that helper in is_daily_cycle_persona, filter advisory identities before registrar reconciliation, report the named enrollment exclusion in the tick summary, and reject direct advisory consume_run calls before any packet claim or ensure_agent call. Keep unrelated consultable behavior unchanged.

Reuse the owner identity helper in the existing fleet purpose classifier so the BFF purpose projection covers the same exclusions. Preserve metadata-free trading behavior and explicit non-trading precedence over paper execution metadata.

Have the standalone probe load the pure helper through the trusted file path, check raw fixture metadata when present, and honor the BFF's advisory purpose projection. Retain existing left_out output and named reasons.

Test all required identity flags in both paper lifecycles, stale daily job cleanup, no ensure/packet side effects, unchanged pool and binding records, metadata-free trading enrollment, and a synthetic 2026-11-27-shaped three-trader/one-servant probe replay.
